verses.translation: About what are they asking one another?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: About the great news[1821] -
That over which they are in disagreement.
No! They are going to know.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Then, no! They are going to know.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
And the mountains as stakes?[1822]
verses.footnotes: [1822]- To stabilize the land and balance the earth.

verses.translation: And We created you in pairs
And made your sleep [a means for] rest
And made the night as clothing[1823]
verses.footnotes: [1823]- Covering you in darkness and providing rest.

verses.translation: And made the day for livelihood
And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
And made [therein] a burning lamp
And sent down from the rain clouds pouring water
That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And gardens of entwined growth.
Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.translation: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, feminine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
For the transgressors, a place of return,
In which they will remain for ages [unending].

segments.description: Time adverb — accusative, masculine, plural, indefinite

verses.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.translation: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
An appropriate recompense.[1824]
verses.footnotes: [1824]- In proportion to and comparable with their crimes.

verses.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
But all things We have enumerated in writing.
"So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."[1825]
verses.footnotes: [1825]- This announcement will be made to the companions of Hell.

verses.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment[1826] -
verses.footnotes: [1826]- Of security, success and reward, including escape and safety from Hell.

verses.translation: Gardens and grapevines
And young women [companions] of equal age.
And a full cup.[1827]
verses.footnotes: [1827]- Of wine which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
verses.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,[1828]
verses.footnotes: [1828]- i.e., as a result of both their own righteous deeds and the limitless generosity of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) . Another meaning is "a gift calculated [to be adequate]."

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
verses.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.[1829]
verses.footnotes: [1829]- None of Allāh's creatures can plead with Him on the Day of Judgement except by His permission.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
verses.translation: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.translation: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.[1830]
verses.footnotes: [1830]- i.e., a direct route through correct beliefs and righteous deeds.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
verses.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth[1831] and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
verses.footnotes: [1831]- i.e., the deeds he did in this world, which await him in the Hereafter.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
